recommendations.description: Dynamically increase async worker concurrency from 32 to 48 ahead of morning batch window.
recommendations.rollback_plan: Issue worker pool scale-down signal back to 32 if queue depth drops below 5 for 10 minutes.

recommendations.description: Increase task queue prefetch buffer from 50 to 120 messages to prevent queue head-of-line blocking.
recommendations.rollback_plan: Revert prefetch count configuration to default 50 via AMQP channel QoS parameter.

recommendations.description: Perform scheduled LRU pruning on expired embedding chunks to maintain memory headroom > 25%.
recommendations.rollback_plan: Re-hydrate cached hot keys from Aurora read replica on cache miss.

recommendations.description: Activate secondary fallback routing pool when primary provider P95 latency exceeds 1500ms.
recommendations.rollback_plan: Route 100% of traffic back to primary provider once health checks confirm P95 < 600ms for 5 consecutive minutes.
